fixes.issue: Interrupted transaction journals used shifting release aliases and could not recover with a newer installer.
fixes.fix: Bind new journals to exact archive hashes; infer legacy transactions only from supported complete archive pairs; validate both files before recovery.
fixes.regression: Legacy committed and interrupted journals across shifted slots; hash-bound journals; unknown external update retained.

fixes.issue: Backup or transaction junctions could redirect writes outside the chosen game.
fixes.fix: Reject linked/non-directory backup paths and linked/non-file recovery entries before recovery or copying.
fixes.regression: Backup and transaction junctions preserve unrelated files and refuse operation.

fixes.issue: A failure writing lock metadata left the installer lock open and prevented retry.
fixes.fix: Write lock metadata inside the cleanup try/finally.
fixes.regression: Injected ENOSPC removes lock, preserves game and permits retry.

fixes.issue: Running-process detection omitted WaitTitleProject and could mistake the installer directory for a game executable.
fixes.fix: Match game executable basenames and collection launcher without crossing path separators.
fixes.regression: Windows CSV and Wine paths; launcher detected, installer path excluded.

compatibility: Supports source plus five historical releases 0.1.0 through 0.4.1. Versioned UI output and complete CTD selection work for 1.0.0.

independentCodeReview.scope: core.cjs, main.cjs and test/core.test.cjs changes with connected recovery/lock/path code
